title: French Defense: Classical Variation
line: A knight hits the center, the bishop breaks the pin, and a pawn strikes the chain.

steps.text: In the French, White's knight came out to guard the pawn on e4.
Bring the knight out. Now the pawn on e4 is attacked twice.

also.f8b4: That is the Winawer Variation, another main line. This lesson goes on with the knight.
also.d5e4: That is the Rubinstein Variation, another main line. This lesson goes on with the knight.

steps.after: White's bishop pins your knight to your queen.

steps.text: Bring the bishop to e7 to break the pin.

also.d5e4: That is also played. This lesson goes on with the bishop.

steps.text: White's pawn kicks your knight. Step back to d7.
Castle. Your king goes to safety, and a rook comes toward the center.

also.a7a6: That is also played. This lesson castles first.

steps.text: Push the pawn on c7 two squares to hit the base of White's chain.
steps.after: Your pawn hits d4, the base of White's chain, and it can open the file for your rook later.

summary: In the Classical, the knight hits the center, the bishop breaks the pin, and a pawn strikes the base of the chain.
